  - Detail：PoCP timeline shifted from Jun to Oct 2025, and NDA timeline shifted for 4 months accordingly
- 行2：
  - Topic：China Integration
  - Detail：to closely monitor the potential implementation of regulatory data exclusivity in China, which will provide market exclusivity and enable China integration

右侧状态栏：
- Global Status
  - gPh IIa ongoing
- China Status
  - participation in gPh III under evaluation

Issue/risk（表格）：
- 表头：Topic | Description | Probability of occurrence | Impact description | Impact level | Mitigation Plan
- 行1：
  - Topic：Patent issue
  - Description：Due to lack of patent and data exclusivity for bioproduct in China, China may not be able to join the global development of this asset.
  - Probability of occurrence：Medium
  - Impact description：This product may not be approved or launched in China.
  - Impact level：Medium
  - Mitigation Plan：To closely monitor the evolution of patent related laws/regulation in China to seek opportunity

页脚：
- Presentation title | ONLY FOR INTERNAL USE
- 42

视觉关系：
- 页面分为三块信息区：左侧为项目基础信息（Name/Mode of Action/Molecule Type/Indication/Stage/给药途径及NDA时间表）；中间为两张表（Key Updates在上，Issue/risk在下）；右侧为状态信息（Global Status与China Status并列呈上下两段）。
- Key Updates表格为“Topic → Detail”的两行对应关系（asset timeline对应时间调整说明；China Integration对应中国监管数据保护监测说明）。
- Issue/risk表格为单条风险记录，按列从左到右依次给出：Topic（Patent issue）→ Description → Probability（Medium）→ Impact description → Impact level（Medium）→ Mitigation Plan。
